description: Free during beta. Public contracts whose term ends soon, so the buyer will likely re-tender: a sales pipeline before tenders are published. Returns buyer, incumbent supplier(s), value, start and expected end date.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

cpv_prefixes.description: CPV code prefixes; '45' = construction, '72' = IT services, '3021' = computers

region.description: Place name: district or municipality (e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Sintra'). Matches the work location or the buyer's name; most precise for Portugal.

name: expiring_contracts
